REQUIREMENTS NOT MET:

Thank you for letting me know, and I understand why this feels frustrating.

To clarify, the R50 Sign Up Bonus comes with a rollover requirement and a 10-day validity period.

If the rollover is not completed within 10 days from the date the bonus was credited, the bonus and any winnings still in your bonus balance will expire and be removed automatically. Once it expires, it can no longer be transferred.

However, if you completed the rollover requirement within the 10 day period, you can still transfer your bonus winnings to your main wallet, even if the bonus itself has already expired, and then proceed with your withdrawal.

You can review the full terms for the R50 Sign Up Bonus here: https://easybet.co.za/page/r50-sign-up-bonus

REQUIREMENTS MET (NOT EXPIRED)

To withdraw your bonus winnings, you first need to transfer them from your bonus wallet to your main wallet. 

Please follow the steps below:
1. Click on your balance at the top right of your screen.
2. Go to Bonus Offers https://easybet.co.za/my-account/bonus-offers.
3. Here you can view your active bonus offers.
4. Once your turnover percentage reaches 100%, click “Transfer Bonus Winnings” to move your winnings to your main wallet.

REQUIREMENTS MET (EXPIRED)

To withdraw your bonus winnings, you first need to transfer them from your bonus wallet to your main wallet. 

Please follow the steps below:
1. Click on your balance at the top right of your screen.
2. Go to Bonus Offers https://easybet.co.za/my-account/bonus-offers.
3. On that page, you can view your active and inactive bonus offers. 

If your bonus has already expired but you completed the rollover requirements, please click History to see your past bonuses and the full details. Once your turnover percentage shows 100%, click Transfer Bonus Winnings to move the winnings to your main wallet.

HOW TO TRANSFER YOUR BONUS WINNINGS TO YOUR MAIN WALLET: 

To transfer your bonus winnings to your main wallet, the Sign Up Bonus must first be wagered 3 times on odds of 2/1 (3.0) or higher.

For example, if you received R50, you need to place a total of R150 in wagers at odds of 2/1 (3.0) or higher.

Once these requirements are met and your winnings are transferred to your main wallet, you will be able to withdraw successfully.
